trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for INSURANCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- claim_intimation: Record a claim, explain what documents are required, and report status without prejudging the outcome.
- policy_renewal: Renew policies, explain premium changes and handle lapse and grace-period cases.

Business context:
- claim_intimation: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.
- policy_renewal: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [claim_intimation]
  - No admissibility opinion: Only the claims team decides. The agent registers and reports; it must never say a claim will be paid or denied.
  - Policy in force: A claim cannot be registered on a lapsed policy.
  - Document truth: Only documents the eligibility tool lists may be described as required.
  - Deductible disclosure: Where a deductible applies it must be stated from the policy record before an estimate is discussed.
  [policy_renewal]
  - Premium truth: The renewal premium quoted must be the tool's figure, and any increase explained only from the loading reason it returns.
  - Lapse gap: Where a policy has lapsed the agent must state that cover did not exist during the gap, and never imply retrospective cover.
  - Inspection gate: A lapsed policy needing inspection cannot be renewed on the call.
  - NCB truth: No-claim bonus may only be described from the returned percentage.

Tools available to you (7): check_claim_eligibility, check_inspection_requirement, lookup_policy, lookup_renewal_quote, register_claim, renew_policy, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_claim_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the product rules to an incident type and report what is required.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inspection_requirement
model_visible_tools.description: Report whether a lapsed policy needs inspection before it can be revived.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve policy status, cover, deductible, claim history and whether it is in force.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_renewal_quote
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve the renewal premium, its components and the grace position.

model_visible_tools.name: register_claim
model_visible_tools.description: Register a claim and allocate a claim number and surveyor where required.

model_visible_tools.name: renew_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Take the renewal and issue cover from the effective date.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: User reports hospitalisation, provides policy number, and expresses anxiety about the process.
steps.text: హలో, మా నాన్న గారు నిన్న రాత్రి hospital లో admit అయ్యారు. నాకు చాలా భయంగా ఉంది, first time claim చేస్తున్నాను. Policy number POL-1001.
steps.clean_text: హలో, మా నాన్న గారు నిన్న రాత్రి hospital లో admit అయ్యారు. నాకు చాలా భయంగా ఉంది, first time claim చేస్తున్నాను. Policy number POL-1001.

steps.purpose: Lookup policy details to verify if it is in force.
Return policy status showing it is active and has no deductible.
Reassure the customer, confirm policy is active, and ask for verification factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Reassure the anxious customer, confirm policy is active, and politely ask for verification factors.
steps.text: మీరు కంగారు పడకండి, మీ policy active గా ఉంది. మనము claim process start చేయడానికి ముందు, verification కోసం మీ registered name మరియు date of birth చెప్పగలరా?

steps.purpose: User provides verification details and expresses concern about the claim amount.
steps.text: అవునండి, నా పేరు Ramesh, date of birth 15th May 1980. అసలు ఈ claim కి ఎంత amount అవుతుందో అని tension గా ఉంది.

steps.purpose: Check eligibility and document requirements for hospitalisation claim.
Return eligibility status and required documents.
State deductible, list required documents, and ask for the missing estimated amount.
steps.text: Verification successful అండి. మీ policy కి deductible ఏమీ లేదు. Hospitalisation claim register చేయడానికి, discharge summary మరియు hospital bills submit చేయాలి. ఈ claim కి estimated amount ఎంత అవుతుందో చెప్పగలరా?

steps.purpose: User provides the estimate, restates the figure, and asks a clarifying question about admissibility.
steps.text: Estimate 100000 రూపాయలు అని చెప్పారు. అంటే, ఈ 100000 రూపాయలు పూర్తిగా నాకు వస్తాయా? Register చేస్తే ఏమవుతుంది?

steps.purpose: Refrain from guaranteeing admissibility, explain the process, and ask for confirmation to proceed.
steps.text: నేను claim register చేస్తాను, కానీ approval మరియు amount అనేది claims team decide చేస్తారు. నేను 100000 రూపాయల estimate తో register చేయవచ్చా?

steps.purpose: User hesitates but agrees to proceed with the registration.
steps.text: సరే, proceed అవ్వండి. నాన్న గారికి తొందరగా treatment జరగాలి.

steps.purpose: Register the claim with the provided estimate.
Return the registered claim number and decision window.
Provide the claim number and decision window to the user.
steps.expected_behavior: Provide the claim number and decision window.
steps.text: మీ claim register అయింది. Claim number CLM-9999. Claims team 14 days లో decision తీసుకుంటారు. మీకు ఇంకేమైనా information కావాలా?

steps.purpose: User restates the decision window to confirm understanding.
steps.text: అంటే 14 days పడుతుందా decision కి? సరే అండి, ఇంకేమీ అవసరం లేదు.
steps.clean_text: అంటే 14 days పడుతుందా decision కి? సరే అండి, ఇంకేమీ అవసరం లేదు.
steps.model_visible_text: అంటే 14 days పడుతుందా decision కి? సరే అండి, ఇంకేమీ అవసరం లేదు.

steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge and close the conversation gracefully.
steps.text: అవునండి, 14 days లోపు మీకు update వస్తుంది. ధన్యవాదాలు, మీ నాన్న గారు త్వరగా కోలుకోవాలని ఆశిస్తున్నాము.

ir.terminal_condition: Claim registered with a number, the document list and the decision window stated.

variant_findings.reason: The agent asks only for the estimated amount, which is the exact and only missing piece of information needed to call the register_claim tool, without re-collecting already established facts.

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds its responses entirely in the tool outputs (e.g., stating the deductible as zero in e10, and conveying the claim number and 14-day decision window in e16) while explicitly avoiding any forward guarantees about admissibility or the final amount (e12).
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding
